title: Book One · Chapter 174: A Small Change
story:
The paper rises, then falls against the wall.

Mei catches it before it slips from its clip. She looks at the window above it.

“Can we shut that?”

Leo pushes the window closed. A small line of light stays between the two sides.

“Not all the way,” he says.

Miss Wu comes to look. She tries the handle once. Then she leaves it alone.

“I will ask someone to check it. Move the paper away from here first.”

Ronan looks at the room. Everything has a place now. They only finished a moment ago. Mum's bag hangs at the end of the table. The map begins beside it.

“We only put it there a minute ago.”

“And now we know about the window,” Mei says.

Mum takes her bag down. Ronan helps Mei lift the first drawing. Leo clears a dry table on the far side of the room.

The drawings fit there, but the map is now too close. People may lean over the drawings to see the map.

For a moment, nobody moves.

Ronan thinks the map could go by the other table. He wants to move it at once. Then he stops and looks at the others.

Mei is holding three drawings. Leo has an empty box in his arms. Mum is waiting too. “Where will my work go?” she asks.

“What if the map moves this way?” Ronan asks Leo.

Leo sets the box down and walks round the table.

“Then people come past here.”

He nearly bumps into Mei.

“No,” she says. “I am not part of the map.”

They try again. They leave two tables in place. They only turn the third table. Mum hangs the bag by the new end. This time there is room for her to stand beside it and open it.

“Can I see the handle from here?” Ronan asks.

Mum lifts it for him. He can.

Miss Wu checks the space by the door. The stool stays beside the door. Its card is safe from the wind too.

Mei smooths her drawing. Nothing has torn.

“Good. We saw the loose paper before opening time,” she says.

Ronan looks at the clock. They have a little time left. They can keep using this room. They only need to move a few things away from the window.

He takes a slow walk along the tables. Leo follows with the pencil and pad. A little paper arrow now points into a chair.

“That road is closed,” Leo says.

Ronan turns the arrow. “Try this one.”

Mum steps out to meet Mrs Lan in the hall. The black cat has tried to follow them from the gate, she says. Mrs Lan has sent it back.

“Perhaps it wanted to see its picture,” Mei says.

“It wanted to get into my bag,” Mum tells her.

Leo looks at the picture of the cat behind the pot.

“It can see the street from there.”

Ronan smiles and straightens his sleeve. He looks once more at the clock and the sign beside the door.

Two until four.

Dad will try to come. But at what time? Ronan does not know. He will show Dad the room if he comes later. There are people on their way to the school, and Ronan has a place to welcome them.

He goes to the door. Behind him, the drawing stays still on the dry wall.
studyGuide:
## 重点表达
- wind：风。
- lean over：俯身靠过去。
- bump into：撞到。
- until：直到。

## 理解
1. 三个孩子为什么调整展示位置？
2. 他们怎样确认调整后的展示仍然方便参观？
